lifecycle_steps: Step 1: Idempotency-key reservation (SQLite status='RESERVED', token, TTL=10s)
Step 2: Broker reservation (_pending_reservation recorded in broker JSON state)
Step 3: Execution-state calculation (sizing validation, fill price, fee & slippage calculation)
Step 4: SQLite status update (commit_order_reservation() updates status='COMMITTED')
Step 5: JSON state persistence (open_position=pos, order_history appended, atomic replace)
Step 6: Order acknowledgement returned to caller

crash_injection_boundaries.boundary_name: Crash after Step 1 (SQLite RESERVED) before Step 2 (Broker Reservation)
crash_injection_boundaries.recovery_behavior: Reservation expires in SQLite after 10s or is released on reboot. Order was never executed.

crash_injection_boundaries.boundary_name: Crash after Step 2 (Broker Reservation) before Step 3 (Calculation)
crash_injection_boundaries.recovery_behavior: On restart, reservation token expires. Broker clears pending reservation.

crash_injection_boundaries.boundary_name: Crash after Step 3 (Calculation) before Step 4 (SQLite COMMITTED)
crash_injection_boundaries.recovery_behavior: Transaction was never committed to SQLite. Key expires. Trade was never executed.

crash_injection_boundaries.boundary_name: Crash after Step 4 (SQLite COMMITTED) before Step 5 (JSON open_position save)
crash_injection_boundaries.json_state: open_position=None, entry fee deducted by commit_order_reservation()
crash_injection_boundaries.recovery_behavior: Key is permanently marked COMMITTED in SQLite. Caller retry is rejected as duplicate. However, open_position was never persisted in JSON, so position is lost.
crash_injection_boundaries.recommendation: Set self.open_position = pos prior to commit_order_reservation() so the single state save inside commit_order_reservation() persists both atomically, or unify broker state store into SQLite.

crash_injection_boundaries.boundary_name: Crash after Step 5 (JSON open_position save) before Step 6 (Caller Ack)
crash_injection_boundaries.recovery_behavior: On restart, state is fully restored. If caller resubmits key, broker rejects duplicate order and preserves open position.
